title: Play, then pause
idea: t1's sideways bookmark with a pause cut through its body, so the notch is the play and two slots are the pause: both of Richard's symbols are negative space in one solid shape. A bookmark marks where you stopped; here its tail resumes and its body pauses.
built: t1's bookmark exactly (37 dp wide, the notch 14/18 of the width as Shelf's in-app play icon, the same corner radii, the apex at the shoulder radius), with the body behind the apex lengthened from 26 to 29.5 dp to hold the pause. The pause is drawn like Shelf's own (Lucide's pause has bars wider than the gap between them): bars 7 x 25 dp with a 4.5 dp gap and r 1 corners. The paper round it is nearly even: 6 dp above and below the bars, 5.5 from the notch's apex to the first bar and from the last bar to the shoulders; the gap between the bars is the narrowest paper on purpose, as in any pause glyph. 58.3 dp long, centred on y 54, the box moved left of centre by half the gap between box centre and centroid. Reach 32.4 dp.
small: 48 px: 24 x 39 px, the notch 18 on a 2 : 3 staircase, bars 5 x 16 with a 3 px gap (the 48 px minimum), 4 px of paper above, below and either side of the pause. 32 px: 16 x 25, notch 12, bars 3 x 10 with a 2 px gap, 3 px above and below, 2 from the apex and 3 to the shoulders. 16 px: the pause would be 1 px slits in 1 px walls, which read as a grille at 1x, so it is dropped and the 16 px cut is t1's notch alone, the same silhouette. Glyph: 14 x 20, a 10 px notch, bars 2 x 8, 2 px apart, so it still says play and pause in the media notification.
risks: Play beside pause is the universal media toggle, so the icon can read as a music, podcast or remote-control app before a reading app; the bookmark is only the frame round the two symbols. A bookmark paired with a play triangle is also Google Play Books' ground. The pause is cut into the body like a stamp, so it is less of a discovery than t1's notch; a quieter pause (bars 5.5 x 20) was tried and still read as play and pause, only weaker. Sideways, the bookmark can read as a tag or a label. In the status bar at 18 px the bars are about 1.5 px wide and soften.
